blocks.text: The 2026 Miss Grand International pageant is set to culminate this Saturday night, October 10, with a “Grand Final” show in Bangkok, Thailand.
Reigning queen Emma Mary Tiglao from the Philippine is set to relinquish her emerald crown to her worthy successor.
Reina Filipinas Angelica Lopez will be competing against 78 other candidates from across the world for the title to bag the country’s third successive crown.
Save this page for live updates and news features on the Miss Grand International 2026 pageant coronation show.
